front_blocks.md: Define **online community**.

back_blocks.md: An online community is a **group of people with a shared common interest who communicate online**.

cards.front_md: Define **online community**.
cards.back_md: An online community is a **group of people with a shared common interest who communicate online**.

front_blocks.md: What two things does every online community have?

back_blocks.md: A **function**, which is what it does for the people who use it, and **features**, which are what enable it to function.

cards.front_md: What two things does every online community have?
cards.back_md: A **function**, which is what it does for the people who use it, and **features**, which are what enable it to function.

front_blocks.md: What is the function of a social networking community?

back_blocks.md: To **allow users to connect through shared interests or relationships**.

cards.front_md: What is the function of a social networking community?
cards.back_md: To **allow users to connect through shared interests or relationships**.

front_blocks.md: How were social networking communities traditionally separated?

back_blocks.md: Into **personal** and **professional** communities.

cards.front_md: How were social networking communities traditionally separated?
cards.back_md: Into **personal** and **professional** communities.

front_blocks.md: What appears on a user's stream, wall or timeline?

back_blocks.md: **Messages from friends and groups**, usually the **first thing a user sees when logged in**, ordered **chronologically**.

cards.front_md: What appears on a user's stream, wall or timeline?
cards.back_md: **Messages from friends and groups**, usually the **first thing a user sees when logged in**, ordered **chronologically**.

front_blocks.md: What happens to the content of a user's status updates?

back_blocks.md: It is **stored by social network providers** and can be used for **targeted advertising**.

cards.front_md: What happens to the content of a user's status updates?
cards.back_md: It is **stored by social network providers** and can be used for **targeted advertising**.

front_blocks.md: What can happen when users share other people's posts?

back_blocks.md: Sharing opens a post or comment to a **wider audience**, which can lead to it **going viral**.

cards.front_md: What can happen when users share other people's posts?
cards.back_md: Sharing opens a post or comment to a **wider audience**, which can lead to it **going viral**.

front_blocks.md: What do tags allow a social networking user to do?

back_blocks.md: Tags allow content to be **categorised**, and users can **search for tags to find content**.

cards.front_md: What do tags allow a social networking user to do?
cards.back_md: Tags allow content to be **categorised**, and users can **search for tags to find content**.

front_blocks.md: How does a platform decide which users to suggest you connect with?

back_blocks.md: Users with **similar interests or shared personal or professional experiences** are suggested.

cards.front_md: How does a platform decide which users to suggest you connect with?
cards.back_md: Users with **similar interests or shared personal or professional experiences** are suggested.

front_blocks.md: What is the function of online gaming?

back_blocks.md: To **allow users to play multiplayer games together** over the internet or a computer network.

cards.front_md: What is the function of online gaming?
cards.back_md: To **allow users to play multiplayer games together** over the internet or a computer network.

front_blocks.md: What are experience points and trophies for in online gaming?

back_blocks.md: They are **rewards for in-game achievements** that **motivate users to continue to play**.

cards.front_md: What are experience points and trophies for in online gaming?
cards.back_md: They are **rewards for in-game achievements** that **motivate users to continue to play**.

front_blocks.md: Name three other features of an online gaming community.

back_blocks.md: **Links to social media**, **user profiles** that showcase achievements, **how-to guides and in-game tutorials**, **discussion boards or forums**, and **notifications**.

cards.front_md: Name three other features of an online gaming community.
cards.back_md: **Links to social media**, **user profiles** that showcase achievements, **how-to guides and in-game tutorials**, **discussion boards or forums**, and **notifications**.

front_blocks.md: What is the function of an online work space?

back_blocks.md: To give users a platform to **collaborate together for the purposes of work**, bringing remote teams and projects together.

cards.front_md: What is the function of an online work space?
cards.back_md: To give users a platform to **collaborate together for the purposes of work**, bringing remote teams and projects together.

front_blocks.md: Name four features of an online work space.

back_blocks.md: **Cloud storage**, **commenting** directly in documents and tasks, a **messaging system**, **shared calendars**, a **contacts list**, **chat rooms**, and **virtual meeting spaces**.

cards.front_md: Name four features of an online work space.
cards.back_md: **Cloud storage**, **commenting** directly in documents and tasks, a **messaging system**, **shared calendars**, a **contacts list**, **chat rooms**, and **virtual meeting spaces**.

front_blocks.md: What is the function of a virtual learning environment?

back_blocks.md: To give **teachers and students a shared platform** to use **learning and assessment features**.

cards.front_md: What is the function of a virtual learning environment?

front_blocks.md: Define **user-generated reference site**.

back_blocks.md: A user-generated reference site is an **information website created and maintained by communities of users**, such as wikis and forums.

cards.front_md: Define **user-generated reference site**.
cards.back_md: A user-generated reference site is an **information website created and maintained by communities of users**, such as wikis and forums.

front_blocks.md: What is the function of a wiki?

back_blocks.md: To allow users to **contribute to a community website or database**, **collaborating** to build and edit web pages.

cards.front_md: What is the function of a wiki?
cards.back_md: To allow users to **contribute to a community website or database**, **collaborating** to build and edit web pages.

front_blocks.md: Name three features of a wiki.

back_blocks.md: **User accounts**, which track edits and who made them; an **editor** for making changes and adding content; and **search tools** for finding content quickly.

cards.front_md: Name three features of a wiki.
cards.back_md: **User accounts**, which track edits and who made them; an **editor** for making changes and adding content; and **search tools** for finding content quickly.

front_blocks.md: What is the function of a forum?

back_blocks.md: To provide users with an **online space for structured discussions**.

cards.front_md: What is the function of a forum?
cards.back_md: To provide users with an **online space for structured discussions**.

front_blocks.md: What is the difference between a moderator and an administrator on a forum?

back_blocks.md: **Moderators** manage discussions and **enforce rules to keep order**, while **administrators** are **in control of the entire forum**, managing users and introducing new features.

cards.front_md: What is the difference between a moderator and an administrator on a forum?

front_blocks.md: What is the difference between a post and a thread?

back_blocks.md: A **post** is a user's message that contributes to a thread, while a **thread** is a **collection of posts about a specific topic**.

cards.front_md: What is the difference between a post and a thread?

front_blocks.md: Define **user-generated content**.

back_blocks.md: User-generated content is content **made by users of sites and services** and **available online**, such as video and photo sharing sites, blogs and vlogs.
